title: Granular billing preview & what-if simulator PRD
creator: Aisha Gomez
description: Build a customer-facing billing preview and internal what-if simulator that lets customers and Sales/CS model invoice impact of configuration changes (plan switches, quota edits, rate-limit policies, reserved credits, burst windows) before the change takes effect. The feature must handle mid-cycle proration, rounded currency math, tax estimation placeholders, and show per-route and per-model cost drivers. The goal is to reduce billing inquiries, increase purchase confidence for plan upgrades, and provide Sales/CS a tool to propose predictable cost scenarios for enterprise negotiations.
context: Customers and internal teams frequently ask for concrete cost estimates: e.g., what happens to next invoice if they increase per-minute concurrency, add a dedicated model, or change quota allocation between routes. Existing docs and invoices are post-hoc; there is no reliable interactive simulation that respects current usage history, committed credits, and entitlement rules. This PRD proposes an interactive preview feature in Console and an internal mode for Sales/CS with extra toggles (taxes, discounts, custom credits).
goals: Expose a clear line-itemized preview of next invoice given a set of planned changes
Support simulation of common actions: plan upgrade/downgrade, add/remove reserved capacity, modify per-route quotas, enable burst windows
Show proration math and clearly label assumptions (time-of-change, invoice window)
Provide exportable PDF/CSV summary for Sales quotes and customer record
Reduce billing support tickets related to predictable changes by 40% within 3 months of launch
non_goals: Replace full invoicing engine — simulator will read from metering snapshots and existing billing rules but will not be used to generate official invoices
Handle complex tax jurisdiction calculations in v1 — show estimated tax ranges and provide note to contact Finance for exact tax liability
Automate account-level promotions or one-off manual credits — those remain subject to Finance approval
scope_notes: v1 is Console-facing with a mirrored internal Sales/CS mode. Coverage: hosted API customers and Dedicated accounts on standard billing. Excluded in v1: on-prem licensing agreements and reseller flows. The simulator will support USD, EUR, and GBP initially and show currency conversion estimates for other currencies.
requirements: Frontend: interactive UI in Console > Billing > Preview with inputs for effective change date, plan selection, per-route quota edits, and custom discount percentages
Backend: deterministic cost engine endpoint that accepts current account snapshot + change-set and returns line-item breakdown and raw calculation metadata
Data: use metering snapshot as-of last billable window; include committed credits, reserved capacity allocations, and usage-to-date
Proration: implement time-weighted proration formula for mid-cycle plan/seat/credit changes with rounding rules matching invoicing
Permissions: internal Sales/CS mode toggles additional flags (apply manual discount estimate, show tax estimate) behind RBAC
Export: generate downloadable CSV and PDF that includes assumptions and a permalink to the simulator state
Audit: store simulator runs for 90 days linked to user and account for reproducibility and support debugging
ux_notes: Primary CTA 'Preview invoice' with a compact result card summarizing delta: total change, estimated next invoice, and key drivers. Drilldowns show per-route, per-model, and per-feature cost lines. UI must surface uncertainty bands (min/expected/max) when estimates rely on projected usage patterns. Internal mode includes 'Apply to quote' button that copies scenario to Sales quoting tool.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account snapshot, simulator returns a deterministic line-itemized preview within 2s for medium accounts (<= 10M tokens/month) and 10s for large accounts (<= 100M tokens/month)
Preview matches Finance invoice generator within ±0.5% for a set of canonical test cases (plan switch mid-cycle, add reserved capacity, change quota allocation)
CSV/PDF export contains all line-items, proration calculations, and a summary of assumptions
Internal Sales/CS mode can toggle tax and discount estimations and export a quote-ready summary
Simulator runs are recorded and retrievable in Console audit view for 90 days
E2E tests cover proration logic, currency rounding rules, and at least five representative customer scenarios
success_metrics: 40% reduction in Billing/Support tickets about predictable changes within 90 days
20% increase in self-serve plan upgrades where customers used the preview tool
NPS lift of +3 in a targeted billing UX survey cohort
>90% match rate between preview and actual invoice for covered scenarios
dependencies: ENG-33721: proration library and canonical rounding spec
ENG-34102: RBAC flags for internal Sales mode
PM-41234: metering snapshot windows and invoice rounding PRD
risks: Mismatch between preview and invoice due to late adjustments or manual credits — mitigated by clear disclaimers and acceptance criteria tests
Performance for very large accounts — mitigate by pre-aggregations and caching of snapshots
Security concerns around exposing internal discount mechanics to customers — internal mode gated by RBAC
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Internal alpha): Launch internal Sales/CS mode with real accounts behind feature flag (2 weeks)
Phase 2 (Beta): Console opt-in for selected self-serve customers (4 weeks)
Phase 3 (GA): Full availability with export and 3-currency support, accompanied by help center content and a live webinar (2 weeks)
Post-GA (30/60/90 day): Monitor metrics, collect feedback, and close gaps between preview and invoices
monitoring_and_alerting: Track mismatch rate between simulator and invoice for canonical scenarios; alert if >1% regression
Latency SLOs for simulator endpoint (P95 < 5s); page for ops dashboard
Audit log ingestion for simulator runs and failed runs metric
